title: Letter Writing
subject: english
body:
← Back to Writing

Formal & Informal Letters

Structure and tone for formal and informal letters; templates for exam practice.

Worked example

Write opening lines for a formal complaint letter.

Solution: "Dear Sir/Madam, I am writing to express my concern regarding..."

Practice

  1. Draft a short informal letter to a friend about a recent trip.
  2. Create a 3-paragraph formal letter to request information.

Brief answers

  1. Informal tone, contractions OK, friendly opening.
  2. Formal: clear subject, polite closing, no contractions.
